title: Yummy Salty Crunchy Filipino Olives Salad
description: A refreshing and energizing Filipino dish that combines the flavors of pitted black olives, lacquer-glaze, and other savory ingredients. Perfect for a quick and easy snack or side dish.
instructions: In a small bowl, whisk together lacquer-glaze, fish sauce, sugar, salt, and black pepper to make the dressing.
In a large bowl, combine pitted black olives, coconut flakes, crushed pecans, minced fresh cilantro, minced fresh mint, and grated ginger.
Add the dressing to the bowl and toss to combine.
Cover the bowl with plastic wrap and refrigerate for at least 30 minutes to allow the flavors to meld.
Just before serving, stir in bamboo shoots and lime juice.
Toss the salad gently to combine and serve chilled.
Arrange the salad on a bamboo tray and garnish with additional cilantro and mint if desired.
Refrigerate any leftovers for up to 2 days.
Serve the salad chilled to enjoy the flavors and textures of the dish.
Use a bamboo skewer to garnish the salad with a sprig of cilantro or mint if desired.
